Laura (eng-runtime): Heads up — noticed a weird latency spike on the Triton path after the midnight deploy. p95 for the model routing to Triton jumped ~2x and a bunch of requests fell back to CUTLASS.
Devon (eng-runtime): :eyes: saw traces too. Is this the seqlen skew we rolled out earlier? Any KV cache churn?
Laura (eng-runtime): KV hit-rate dropped from ~92% -> ~66% around 00:12 UTC. Sequence length distribution also shifted (more long prompts). I think the probe samples chose CUTLASS for longer seqs and hysteresis was too short so it bounced.
Mike (eng-runtime): I pulled flame graphs from the canary host. Short summary:
```
Triton: p50 11ms p95 42ms mem 12.3GB
Cutlass: p50 10ms p95 58ms mem 9.1GB
Observed: cutlass p95 worse for long seqs, but triton throughput dropped under KV-cold bursts
```
Anjali (eng-ml): Could be KV cache eviction pattern. Recent prompt prefixing increases KV footprint per session. More misses => triton path doing extra mem transfers.
Laura (eng-runtime): That's consistent with traces: Triton exec nodes had more memcpy stalls when KV miss rate rose. The routing decider currently uses probe_score = latency_est + alpha * mem_overhead; alpha tuned low. When mem_overhead spiked probes favored CUTLASS.
Devon (eng-runtime): Do we have telemetry to show probe sampling rates over time? perf-bot, can you dump the routing probe histogram for the window 00:00-00:30?
perf-bot: Routing probe histogram (00:00-00:30): Triton samples 120, Cutlass samples 380, Probe fail->fallback 47, avg_probe_latency_triton 38ms, avg_probe_latency_cutlass 44ms
Mike (eng-runtime): Hmm probe_count skewed because sample selector used seqlen > 512 -> prefer cutlass. That rule was added last month.
Laura (eng-runtime): Proposed mitigations:
  - Increase probe hysteresis to 5m (was 1m)
  - Cap probe-based route flips per-host per-model to 3/hour
  - Add KV-hit-aware bias: treat KV_hit_rate < 80% as 'cold' and prefer Triton if mem_headroom > X
  - Roll back the seqlen-only cutoff for probe sampling
Devon (eng-runtime): I like the hysteresis and cap. The KV-hit-aware bias might be racy though — need to compute aggregated hit-rate not per-request.
Mike (eng-runtime): Quick regex for extracting KV hit rate from traces:
```
jq -r '.spans[] | select(.name=="kv_lookup") | .tags.hit' traces.json | awk '{print $1}' | stats
```
Laura (eng-runtime): Also we should add a safety-net route: if fallback to cutlass increases p95 for the overall request (not just kernel p95) by > 20% over baseline, auto-revert to Triton preferred for that model for 10m. This prevents oscillation impacting customers.
Anjali (eng-ml): We should also run a targeted microbenchmark: simulate KV miss patterns with seqlen mix {32:50%, 512:30%, 2048:20%} and measure triton vs cutlass p50/p95/cost. I can set that up.
Devon (eng-runtime): Action items:
  - Mike: attach the full flame graphs and raw probe telemetry to the ticket (INC-4132)
  - Laura: open PR to bump hysteresis + cap and add safety-net revert logic (small change to kernel-router)
  - Anjali: schedule microbench and share results by EOD
  - Ops: abort canary and pin fallback-disabled until we get mitigations in place (I'll ping them now)
Mike (eng-runtime): Uploaded flame graphs + perf counters to INC-4132 and added a short reproduction script in inc-4132/repro.sh
Laura (eng-runtime): Re: quick repro command for local tracing if anyone needs it:
```
redwoodctl trace run --model llama-70b --window 00:00:30 --inject-kv-miss=0.35 --seq-distribution "32:0.5,512:0.3,2048:0.2" > traces.json
```
Devon (eng-runtime): Rolled back canary at 00:42 UTC — monitoring now. Keeping probe sampling disabled until PR lands.
perf-bot: Canary rollback triggered by Devon at 00:42 UTC. Alert suppressed.
Anjali (eng-ml): Starting the microbench now. If we confirm that Triton still wins on throughput despite mem overhead for mixed seqs, we should update the autotuner to weight end-to-end p95 not just kernel p95.
Laura (eng-runtime): Good point — autotuner today only sees kernel exec time. We need a composite metric: end_to_end_latency = kernel_latency + kv_penalty_estimate + queue_delay.
Mike (eng-runtime): Filed follow-up task AUTOTUNE-58 to add composite metric + probe sampling blacklist for models with high KV churn.
Laura (eng-runtime): Thanks everyone. If you see any customer-facing errors ping #support and I'll coordinate. We'll reconvene after Anjali's bench and the PR review. :thumbsup:
